# Area budget

*Generated by `make synth` (synth/report.py) from Yosys + ABC mapped to the IHP CMOS5L liberty `sg13cmos5l_stdcell_typ_1p20V_25C.lib`. Pre-layout: expect LibreLane to add 20% to 50% for buffering, clock tree and hold fixing. Hand estimates use the bottom-up method from the research doc's Numbers tab.*

Budget: 6x4 tiles at 60% density = 549,700 µm² of standard cells. Planning rule: keep the synthesized total times 1.3 under 75% of that.

| Module | What | Instances | Cells (each) | Area µm² (each) | Area µm² (all) | % of budget | Hand estimate µm² |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `weft_pmem` | Program memory 128 x 16, flops + read mux | 1 | 6,229 | 168,523 | 168,523 | 30.7% | 166,440 |
| `weft_core` | Core: PC, decoder, ALU, flags, pin registers, cycle counter | 1 | 1,286 | 15,129 | 15,129 | 2.8% | 10,000 |
| `weft_regfile` | Register file 8 x 16, 3 read ports | 1 | 686 | 13,759 | 13,759 | 2.5% | 11,759 |
| `weft_fifo` | FIFO 4 x 16 (each) | 2 | 193 | 5,699 | 11,398 | 2.1% | 5,200 |
| `weft_host_spi` | Host SPI port | 1 | 592 | 9,429 | 9,429 | 1.7% | 4,000 |
| `weft_crc` | CRC/LFSR 16-bit, programmable | 1 | 268 | 3,680 | 3,680 | 0.7% | 2,540 |
| `weft_timer` | Bit timer: period, counter, tick | 1 | 206 | 3,246 | 3,246 | 0.6% | 3,081 |
| `weft_sync` | Synchronizers, 16 inputs x 3 flops | 1 | 96 | 2,787 | 2,787 | 0.5% | 2,352 |
| `tt_um_fuzzylogique_weft` | Top-level glue | 1 | 2 | 15 | 15 | 0.0% | 0 |
| **total** | flattened design | | | | **227,964** | **41.5%** | ~215,000 |

- Flip-flops: 2,621 (`dfrbpq_1`, 128,403 µm², 56% of the area). 2,048 of them are the program memory.
- With the 1.3 planning factor: 296,354 µm² = 54% of the budget. The 75% ceiling is 412,275 µm².
- Logic excluding program memory: 59,442 µm². Halving the memory to 64 words (`PMEM_AW = 6`) would save about 84,261 µm².
- Measured numbers from the Tiny Tapeout `gds` action (utilization, slack after place and route) go here once the first run completes.
